source: the Forever server's pinned LSB reference tree (r3), read only; the one the platform's era-gates analysis pins
transform: ja rows: abilityId, job (1..22, 0 other), level, content_tag (NULL -> BASE) for every ability with a job or a tag; ws rows: weaponskillid and the bit mask (bit job-1) of the nonzero bytes of the `jobs` binary(22) for every skill with a nonzero mask. Ids only, no names. Client ability id = 0x200 + abilityId for job abilities and pet commands; weapon skill id as is (verified by the ignored owned-DAT test ability_era::...).
assumptions: level is an assumption (LSB's learn level may differ from the 2002 retail one); the ws `jobs` bytes are read only as 'some byte set' per job
